#Library Set Up

```{r Library Setup}
#creating percentages and tidying data
library(dplyr)
#mixed model
library(glmmTMB)
#anova
library(car)
#find the four way interaction
library(brms)
#check model fits
library(DHARMa)
#post-hoc contrasts for models 
library(emmeans)
#GGPlot for graphing
library(ggplot2)
```

#Import and Clean Data 

````{r Import Data Set}
setwd("/Users/niamhmccartan/Documents/College/PhD/Papers/CS_Timing/CS_Timing_R")

coldsnap<-read.csv("CS_Timing.csv", 
                 header = TRUE, 
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
```{r Remove early deaths, males and uninfected controls}
CS <- subset(coldsnap, Include == "Yes")
```

```{r Set Variables}
CS$A_Temp<-as.numeric(CS$A_Temp)
CS$Real_Avg<-as.numeric(CS$Real_Avg)
CS$Bath<-as.factor(CS$Bath)
CS$Timing<-as.factor(CS$Timing)
CS$Amplitude<-as.factor(CS$Amplitude)
CS$Duration<-as.factor(CS$Duration)
CS$Infection<-as.numeric(CS$Infection)
CS$Spores<-as.numeric(CS$Spores)
```
```{r Specifying Order of Factors}
CS$Timing <- factor(CS$Timing, levels = c("Constant", "Before", "During", "After"))
CS$Amplitude <- factor(CS$Amplitude, levels = c("0", "-3", "-6"))
CS$Duration <- factor(CS$Duration, levels = c("0", "3", "6"))
```
```{r Make Treatment Column}
CS$Treatment <- paste(CS$Amplitude, CS$Duration)
CS$Treatment <- as.factor(CS$Treatment)
CS$Treatment <- factor(CS$Treatment, levels = c("0 0", "-3 3", "-3 6", "-6 3", "-6 6"))
```
```{r Adding Proportion Infected and Standard Error of Burden Column}
CS = CS %>%
  group_by(Treatment, A_Temp, Timing) %>% 
  #Make proportion infected columns 
  add_count(Treatment) %>% 
  mutate(
    nn = sum(Infection != 0),
    Prop = nn/n,
  #creating binomial confidence intervals
  se.I = sqrt(Prop * (1-Prop)/n),
  lower.I = pmax(Prop - (se.I * 1.96), 0),
  upper.I = pmin(Prop + (se.I * 1.96), 1)
  ) %>% 
  
  #Make standard error columns
  mutate(
    mean = mean(Spores, na.rm = T),
    sd.B = sd(Spores, na.rm = T),
    se.B = sd.B/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r Centre Average Temperature}
# Centering the 'Real_Avg' variable
CS$Real_Avg_Cent <- scale(CS$Real_Avg, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
CS$Real_Avg_Cent <- as.numeric(CS$Real_Avg_Cent)
```
```{r Make Timing_Treatment column}
CS$Timing_Treatment <- paste(CS$Timing, CS$Treatment)
CS$Timing_Treatment <- factor(CS$Timing_Treatment, levels = c("Constant 0 0", 	
                                                    "Before -3 3", "Before -3 6", "Before -6 3", "Before -6 6",
                                                    "During -3 3", "During -3 6", "During -6 3", "During -6 6",
                                                    "After -3 3", "After -3 6", "After -6 3", "After -6 6"))
```
```{r Extra Subsets}
CS$Snap <- ifelse(CS$Treatment == "0 0", "No", "Yes")
CS$Snap <- factor(CS$Snap, levels = c("No", "Yes"))

#Subset for only core average temperatures
CSC <- subset(CS, A_Temp %in% c("14","17","20","23"))
CSC$Real_Avg_Cent <- scale(CSC$Real_Avg, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
CSC$Real_Avg_Cent <- as.numeric(CSC$Real_Avg_Cent)
CSC$A_Temp <- as.factor(CSC$A_Temp)

CSC_snap <- droplevels(subset(CSC, Snap == "Yes"))

CS.NA <- CS %>% filter(!is.na(Spores))

CSC.NA <- CSC %>% filter(!is.na(Spores))
CSC_snap.NA <- droplevels(subset(CSC.NA, Snap == "Yes"))
```
```{r Timing Subsets Infection}
#making a subset by each timing and constant controls 
CSI.before <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("Before","Constant")) 
CSI.during <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("During","Constant"))
CSI.after <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("After","Constant"))
```
```{r Timing Subsets Burden}
#making a subset by each timing and constant controls 
CSB.before <- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("Before","Constant")) 
CSB.during<- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("During","Constant"))
CSB.after <- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("After","Constant"))
```

#Infection Model

```{r Infection model 1 - comparing all treatments and timing}
# Q1: does a snap happen at all matter, vs constant control?
presence.CSI <- glmmTMB(Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent,2) * Timing + (1|Bath),
                         family = binomial, data = CSC)

summary(presence.CSI)

Anova(presence.CSI, type = "III")

#LRT check

presence.CSI.linear <- glmmTMB(Infection ~ Real_Avg_Cent * Timing + (1|Bath),
                               family = binomial, data = CSC)

anova(presence.CSI.linear, presence.CSI)

#post-hoc tests: timing’s linear and quadratic terms against Constant

emt.CSI <- emtrends(presence.CSI, ~ Timing, var = "Real_Avg_Cent", max.degree = 2)
emt.CSI
contrast(emt.CSI, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "Constant", adjust = "BH")
```

```{r Infection Treatment Model exploration}
# Q2: among snaps that occurred, how do amplitude and duration (now a true 2x2) matter?
severity.quad.CSI <- glmmTMB(
  Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * Timing * Amplitude * Duration + (1|Bath),
      family = binomial, data = CSC_snap,
      control = glmmTMB::glmmTMBControl(optCtrl = list(iter.max = 1000, eval.max = 1000)))
summary(severity.quad.CSI)
severity.CSI <- glmmTMB(Infection ~ Real_Avg_Cent * Timing * Amplitude * Duration + (1|Bath),
                         family = binomial, data = CSC_snap)
severity.quad.CSI.reduced <- glmmTMB(
  Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * (Timing + Amplitude + Duration)
              + Timing:Amplitude + Timing:Duration + Amplitude:Duration + (1|Bath),
  family = binomial, data = CSC_snap)
severity.CSI.reduced <- glmmTMB(
  Infection ~ Real_Avg_Cent * (Timing + Amplitude + Duration)
              + Timing:Amplitude + Timing:Duration + Amplitude:Duration + (1|Bath),
  family = binomial, data = CSC_snap)

anova(severity.quad.CSI.reduced, severity.CSI.reduced, severity.quad.CSI, severity.CSI)  # LRT: is the 4-way interaction justified?
```

```{r Infection model 2 - to see cold snap treatments}
severity.CSI <- glmmTMB(
  Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * (Timing + Amplitude + Duration)
              + Timing:Amplitude + Timing:Duration + Amplitude:Duration + (1|Bath),
  family = binomial, data = CSC_snap)

summary(severity.CSI)

Anova(severity.CSI, type = "III")
```

```{r Infection brms models to find the four way interraction for treatment terms only}
# Start with the same structure as severity.CSI.reduced as your primary comparison point,
# then a fuller version with interactions re-added, letting priors handle instability

severity.brm.reduced.CSI <- brm(
  Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * (Timing + Amplitude + Duration)
              + Timing:Amplitude + Timing:Duration + Amplitude:Duration
              + (1 | Bath),
  family = bernoulli(),
  data = CSC_snap,
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "b"),        # weakly informative on fixed effects
    prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")        # prior on random-effect SD
  ),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 123
)

# Fuller model, including three-way and four-way interaction terms
severity.brm.full.CSI <- brm(
  Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * Timing * Amplitude * Duration
              + (1 | Bath),
  family = bernoulli(),
  data = CSC_snap,
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd")
  ),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r Checks for the brms infection models to justify using the reduced model}
severity.brm.reduced.CSI <- add_criterion(severity.brm.reduced.CSI, "loo")
severity.brm.full.CSI <- add_criterion(severity.brm.full.CSI, "loo")
loo_compare(severity.brm.reduced.CSI, severity.brm.full.CSI)

fixef(severity.brm.full.CSI, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
#so A Bayesian model with weakly informative priors did sample successfully, but LOO comparison showed no improvement over the reduced (two-way-interaction) model (Δelpd = -1.8, SE = 2.1).

fixef(severity.brm.reduced.CSI, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))

```

```{r DHARMa infection model checks for fits}
# for each chosen model, simulate residuals and check them
sim_presence.CI <- simulateResiduals(presence.CSI, n = 1000)
plot(sim_presence.CI)

sim_severity.CI <- simulateResiduals(severity.CSI, n = 1000)
plot(sim_severity.CI)
```

#Infection Contrast Comparisons

```{r create factored model to find treatment outcomes}
#Model used because glmmTMB didn't converge
posthoc.CSI <- glm(Infection ~ A_Temp * Timing_Treatment, family = binomial, data = CSC)

# could also try: family = tweedie(var.power = 2)
emm.CSI <- emmeans(posthoc.CSI , ~ A_Temp * Timing_Treatment, data = CSC)
emm.CSI
```

#Infection Graphs Separated

```{r Timing Infection Presence Subsets}
#make new presence column 
CS$Presence <- ifelse(CS$Treatment == "0 0", "Constant", "Snap")
CS$Presence <- factor(CS$Presence, levels = c("Constant", "Snap"))

#get binomial errors
CS = CS %>%
  group_by(Presence, A_Temp, Timing) %>%
  add_count(Presence, name = "n.P") %>%
  mutate(
    nn.P = sum(Infection != 0),
    Prop.P = nn.P/n.P,
    se.I.P = sqrt(Prop.P * (1-Prop.P)/n.P),
    lower.I.P = pmax(Prop.P - (se.I.P * 1.96), 0),
    upper.I.P = pmin(Prop.P + (se.I.P * 1.96), 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#create subgroups
CSI.pres.before <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("Before", "Constant"))
CSI.pres.during <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("During", "Constant"))
CSI.pres.after  <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("After", "Constant"))
```

```{r Before Infection Presence}
CSI.pres.before.plot <- ggplot(CSI.pres.before, aes(x = A_Temp, y = Prop.P, colour = Presence, shape = Presence, fill = Presence)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 4) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = A_Temp, y = Prop.P, colour = Presence, linetype = Presence),
              method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), formula = y ~ poly(x,2),
              se = FALSE, size = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.I.P, ymax = upper.I.P), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17),
        legend.position = "none") +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 23)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#999999", "#3a87c7")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#999999", "#3a87c7")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(8, 23, 3)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))

CSI.pres.before.plot

ggsave("CSI.pres.before.plot.png", width = 8.5, height = 6)
```

#Burden Model

```{r Burden model 1 - comparing all treatments and timing}
presence.CSB <- glmmTMB(Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent,3) * Timing + (1|Bath),
                         family = nbinom12, data = CSC.NA)

#double check that cubic is more suitable over quadratic 
presence.CSB.quad <- glmmTMB(Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * Timing + (1|Bath),
                              family = nbinom12, data = CSC.NA)

anova(presence.CSB.quad, presence.CSB)  # quadratic vs cubic, nested, valid LRT <- cubic is better 

summary(presence.CSB)

Anova(presence.CSB, type = "III")
```

```{r Burden model 2 - to see cold snap treatments}
severity.CSB <- glmmTMB(
  Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3) * (Timing + Amplitude + Duration)
              + Timing:Amplitude + Timing:Duration + Amplitude:Duration + (1|Bath),
  family = nbinom12(), data = CSC_snap.NA)

#double check that cubic is more suitable over quadratic (it's not)
severity.CSB.quad <- glmmTMB(
  Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * (Timing + Amplitude + Duration)
              + Timing:Amplitude + Timing:Duration + Amplitude:Duration + (1|Bath),
  family = nbinom12(), data = CSC_snap.NA)

#try running full model - SE for high powered interractions are very high 
severity.full.CSB <- glmmTMB(
  Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3) * Timing * Amplitude * Duration + (1|Bath),
  family = nbinom12(), data = CSC_snap.NA)

anova(severity.CSB.quad, severity.CSB) # quadratic vs cubic, nested, valid LRT <- cubic is better 
anova(severity.CSB, severity.full.CSB) # check reduced vs full 

summary(severity.CSB)

Anova(severity.CSB, type = "III")
```

```{r Burden brms models to find the four way interraction for treatment terms only}
# Burden brms models: reduced (main effects + two-way) vs full (three/four-way interactions)

severity.brm.reduced.CSB <- brm(
  Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3) * (Timing + Amplitude + Duration)
              + Timing:Amplitude + Timing:Duration + Amplitude:Duration
              + (1 | Bath),
  family = negbinomial(),
  data = CSC_snap.NA,
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
    prior(gamma(0.01, 0.01), class = "shape")   # weak prior on NB shape parameter
  ),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 123
)

# Fuller model, including three-way and four-way interaction terms
severity.brm.full.CSB <- brm(
  Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3) * Timing * Amplitude * Duration
              + (1 | Bath),
  family = negbinomial(),
  data = CSC_snap.NA,
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
    prior(gamma(0.01, 0.01), class = "shape")
  ),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.999, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 123
)
```

```{r Checks for the brms burden models to justify using the reduced model}
# Checks for the brms burden models to justify using the reduced model
severity.brm.reduced.CSB <- add_criterion(severity.brm.reduced.CSB, "loo")
severity.brm.full.CSB <- add_criterion(
  severity.brm.full.CSB, "loo",
  moment_match = TRUE
)
loo_compare(severity.brm.reduced.CSB, severity.brm.full.CSB)

fixef(severity.brm.full.CSB, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
fixef(severity.brm.reduced.CSB, probs = c(0.05, 0.95))
```

```{r DHARMa burden model checks for fits}
sim_presence.CSB <- simulateResiduals(presence.CSB, n = 1000)
plot(sim_presence.CSB)

sim_severity.CSB <- simulateResiduals(severity.CSB, n = 1000)
plot(sim_severity.CSB)
```

```{r Check DHARMa residuals}
plotResiduals(sim_presence.CSB, form = CSC.NA$Real_Avg_Cent)  

plotResiduals(sim_severity.CSB, form = CSC_snap.NA$Real_Avg_Cent)  
```

```{r Burden model CHOSEN - chosen after DHARMa checks}
presence.disp.CSB <- glmmTMB(
  Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3) * Timing + (1|Bath),
  dispformula = ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3),
  family = nbinom12,
  data = CSC.NA
)

# re-run diagnostics
sim_presence.disp.CSB <- simulateResiduals(presence.disp.CSB, n = 1000)

plotResiduals(sim_presence.disp.CSB, form = presence.disp.CSB$frame$Real_Avg_Cent)

summary(presence.disp.CSB)

Anova(presence.disp.CSB, type = "III")

#post-hoc tests: timing’s linear and quadratic terms against Constant

emt.CSB <- emtrends(presence.disp.CSB, ~ Timing, var = "Real_Avg_Cent", max.degree = 3)
emt.CSB
contrast(emt.CSB, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "Constant", adjust = "BH")
```

```{r Custom Contrasts Spores}
contrast(EMM.CSB, adjust = "BH", method = list(
  "14 -33B v 00C Before"  = T14.33B.CSB - T14.00C.CSB,
  "14 -36B v 00C Before"  = T14.36B.CSB - T14.00C.CSB,
  "14 -63B v 00C Before"  = T14.63B.CSB - T14.00C.CSB,
  "14 -66B v 00C Before"  = T14.66B.CSB - T14.00C.CSB,
  "14 -36B v -33B Before" = T14.36B.CSB - T14.33B.CSB,

#Burden Graphs Separated
```{r Timing Burden Presence Subsets}
CS.NA = CS.NA %>%
  group_by(Presence, A_Temp, Timing) %>%
  mutate(
    mean.P.B = mean(Spores, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd.B.P = sd(Spores, na.rm = TRUE),
    se.B.P = sd.B.P/sqrt(sum(!is.na(Spores)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

CSB.pres.before <- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("Before", "Constant"))
CSB.pres.during <- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("During", "Constant"))
CSB.pres.after  <- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("After", "Constant"))
```

```{r Before Burden Presence}
CSB.pres.before.plot <- ggplot(CSB.pres.before, aes(x = A_Temp, y = Spores, colour = Presence, shape = Presence, fill = Presence)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = A_Temp, y = Spores, colour = Presence, linetype = Presence),
              method = "glm.nb", formula = y ~ poly(x, 3), se = FALSE, size = 0.75) +
  stat_summary(aes(y = mean.P.B), fun = "mean", geom = "point", size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean.P.B - se.B.P, ymax = mean.P.B + se.B.P), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16)) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(22, 23), labels = c("Constant", "Cold Snap")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#999999", "#3a87c7"), labels = c("Constant", "Cold Snap")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#999999", "#3a87c7"), labels = c("Constant", "Cold Snap")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed"), labels = c("Constant", "Cold Snap")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(8, 23, 3)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,800))

CSB.pres.before.plot

ggsave("CSB.pres.before.plot.png", width = 8.5, height = 6)
```

```{r 14 Degree Amplitude vs Duration (Day -10)}
Before14.Plot.CSB <- ggplot(Before14.CSB, aes(x = Amplitude, y = Spores, colour = Duration)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 78, ymax = 118),
            fill = "#ECECEC", alpha = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 98, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") + # Line for constant treatment
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se.B, ymax =  mean + se.B), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),

        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.65, 0.85), 
        legend.key = element_blank(),  # Removes the box around the legend symbol
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  scale_colour_manual("CS Duration", values = c("#40B46A","#966AEA"), 
                      labels = c("3 Days", "6 Days")) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,800))
